title: Align GLOBAL instructions with D10-D13, D18, D21 and D22
body:
GLOBAL AGENTS.md demands a full local gate (D11 says CI runs it), the delegate and delivery-loop skills give model and judge policy that contradicts D18/D22, the repair loop has no round limit where it is owned (D10), D12/D13 have no owner, global krn does not forward review, wayfinder can default to a markdown tracker, and krn_capsule.py tells sessions to claim tasks.
Acceptance: one owner per rule in GLOBAL config/AGENTS.md and skills, matching ADR 0014; pinned instruction tests updated; changes check clean.

Latest operator scope and independent Opus5.5 audit require removing the global authorship/delegation mandate from config/AGENTS.md and reversing its instruction-ownership assertions. Restore ADR0010 amendment2026-10-14: the lead may implement clear accepted bounded work, delegation is selected for useful parallelism, complexity/context or independent evidence, and independent review remains required. Keep KRN workflow local to adopting repositories; do not use the universal global contract to force a tracker, worker wrapper or model procedure elsewhere. Record the clarified decision and its actual reasons in the next owned Product decision/docs change; do not claim the Opus report is code acceptance or measured savings. Source and host changes are not yet applied.
